messages.content: Explain PL/I OPEN and CLOSE statements for sequential file handling. Provide a working code example.
How do READ and WRITE statements work in PL/I for sequential file processing? Show code with error handling.
Describe RECORD I/O in PL/I and how it differs from stream I/O. Include a practical example.
Explain VSAM file access in PL/I using keyed and sequential access patterns. Provide working examples.
Show a complete PL/I program demonstrating mixed I/O operations: reading from a sequential file, validating records, writing to VSAM, and logging errors to a sequential output file.
